sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents suspected card-not-present fraud involving cardholder Aria C. under account CUST_7821. On September 24, 2026, multiple automated authorizations occurred in rapid sequence totaling $1,840.00 USD across high-risk digital merchant gateways. Graph analysis resolved a secondary linked card attempting concurrent authorizations from an identical IP subnet. The institution enacted preventative holds and filed this report in full compliance with FinCEN standards.
